values.meaning: bonus movement speed on successful impale

mechanics.claim: Skarner winds up over the cast time before the damage/suppression lashes out.
mechanics.quote: winds up his stingers over the cast time, then lashes them forward

mechanics.claim: During Impale's enemy disable phase, Skarner cannot basic attack, cast Q or E, but can still cast W.
mechanics.quote: cast={{ai|Q|Skarner}} and {{ai|E|Skarner}} are disabled, but can be buffered. {{ai|W|Skarner}} is usable.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts on cast, not on the effect ending.
If cast during Shattered Earth, Skarner automatically casts Upheaval in the direction of Impale's cast without incurring its own cast time.
mechanics.quote: '''Skarner''' {{tt|automatically casts|Without incurring Upheaval's cast time}} {{ai|Upheaval|Skarner}} in the direction of Impale's cast

mechanics.claim: The movement speed bonus only applies if at least one enemy champion is successfully impaled.
mechanics.quote: If he successfully impales at least one enemy champion, '''Skarner''' gains {{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}} for the same duration.
